scenarios.title: Exiling a permanent moves it from the battlefield to exile
decisions: A casts Swords to Plowshares targeting Hill Giant, tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Swords to Plowshares resolves.

variants.label: exiled
variants.expected: Hill Giant moves from the battlefield to exile, not to the graveyard. B gains 3 life and is at 23.

variants.label: target_returned
variants.delta: With Swords to Plowshares on the stack, B casts Unsummon targeting Hill Giant, tapping Island, and Unsummon resolves first.
variants.expected: Hill Giant returns to B's hand. Swords to Plowshares fizzles: nothing is exiled and B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: Exiling by name moves cards from hand, graveyard and library, but not from the battlefield
decisions: A casts Memoricide, naming Grizzly Bears and targeting B, tapping four Swamps.
Both players pass; Memoricide resolves and A takes every Grizzly Bears A finds.

variants.label: name_present
variants.expected: The Grizzly Bears in B's hand, graveyard and library each move to exile. The Grizzly Bears on B's battlefield and Hill Giant in B's library are untouched.

variants.label: name_absent
variants.delta: A names Typhoid Rats instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: No card with that name is in B's hand, graveyard or library, so nothing is exiled. All of B's Grizzly Bears stay where they are.

scenarios.title: A spell can be exiled from the stack

setup.notes: B's hand holds both counterspells; the base variant casts Dissipate.

decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting B, tapping Mountain.
B casts the counterspell named in the variant targeting Lightning Bolt, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; the counterspell resolves.

variants.label: dissipate
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt is countered and moves from the stack to exile. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: cancel
variants.delta: B casts Cancel instead of Dissipate.
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt is countered and moves from the stack to A's graveyard, not to exile. B's life stays 20.
